description: Reference verdicts for experimental collection copies: the buyer's merged view of a seller copy and the publisher's adagents.json (shared by include_collections and list_collections), list_collections seller responses, collection_card.* and collection_catalog.bulk_change webhook payloads, and how a card mirror applies a sequence of events. Merge and mirror vectors give the expected output; response and webhook vectors list every rule the input breaks in expected.violations, using the codes in violation_codes (an empty list means conformant). The shape is experimental and may change with the feature.

conventions.key: A collection is keyed by (publisher_domain, collection_id).
conventions.fixtures: fixtures holds the declarations, seller_authorized and seller_catalog that a vector uses unless it carries its own.
conventions.declarations: declarations maps a publisher_domain to the collections array of that publisher's adagents.json. seller_authorized lists the collection selectors the grader resolved from that file's authorized_agents for the selling agent; resolving authorized_agents is outside these vectors. A selector without collection_ids covers every collection the publisher declares.
conventions.closed_list: A verified copy wins over the declaration only on images, sample_content, url, description, season, cadence and distribution[].followers. A copy that omits one of those fields leaves the declared value. Every other field comes from the declaration.
conventions.followers: A copy's distribution entry corresponds to the declared entry with the same publisher_domain; when several declared entries share it, to the one with the same identifiers set. A copy's followers replace only the corresponding declared entry's followers. Copy distribution entries with no corresponding declared entry are ignored, and declared entries the copy omits keep their followers.
conventions.merged_status: verified: one copy, declared, and the seller authorized; effective is the declaration overlaid with the closed list. unverified: one copy that is undeclared or from an unauthorized seller; effective is null and display is the copy as served. unresolvable: more than one copy for the key; effective is the declaration. fallback: no copy; effective is the declaration. unknown: no copy and no declaration. display is what a buyer may show: the copy for unverified, effective otherwise. carriage_eligible is true only when the key is declared, because carriage verification reads distribution only from the declaration. effective carries publisher_domain so it has the same shape as a copy.
conventions.keys: keys are the collections the buyer resolves: those referenced by returned products for include_collections, or those it requested or received for list_collections. Copies for other keys are strays and are ignored.
conventions.catalog: seller_catalog is the seller's record of its cards (the copy every read and webhook serves for that key) and who can see each one: public, or a list of account_ids.
conventions.matching: Selectors: a card matches when a selector has its publisher_domain and either no collection_ids or one equal to its collection_id. Filters: values within one filter are OR, filters are AND. kinds compares kind (absent means series). statuses compares status. languages uses RFC 4647 basic filtering, case-insensitive. genres_include needs a shared genre value (and the same genre_taxonomy when the filter names one); genres_exclude removes a card sharing one. talent matches talent[].brand_ref by domain and, when the filter gives one, brand_id. platforms matches distribution[].publisher_domain. name_contains is a case-insensitive substring of name.
conventions.completeness: A missing entry is graded only when the response is listed, is the first page (no request cursor), and has no next page.
conventions.token_scope: A collections_version is scoped to the canonicalized selectors and filters (arrays as sets, pagination.cursor excluded), plus account_id when its cache_scope is account. token_issued_for records the scope of the presented token.
conventions.adcp_version: The caller version is request.adcp_version, compared by major and minor. Below 3.3, the only conformant answer is an UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE task error.
conventions.mirror: A mirror holds one cache_scope: its stored version, the event_id of the last applied event, and its cards. Events apply in arrival order. A delivery is skipped when its idempotency_key or notification_id was already applied. A failed signature, a previous_wholesale_feed_version that differs from the stored version, or an event_id lower than the last applied one (UUID v7 order) stops application with verdict repair_conditional and the stored, last applied version as repair_token, never the webhook's version. collection_catalog.bulk_change stops application with verdict repair_full and no token. Otherwise collection_card.updated upserts the card, collection_card.removed deletes the key, and the mirror stores the event's version and event_id. expected.mirror is the state when application stops.

violation_codes.schema_invalid: A request, response, task error, or webhook fails its JSON Schema. A grader reports only this code for the vector.
violation_codes.feature_not_declared: The seller serves list_collections or lists card events without media_buy.collection_catalog, or lists media_buy.collection_catalog without media_buy.collection_cards.
violation_codes.version_gate: A caller whose adcp_version is below 3.3 is served list_collections instead of an UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE task error.
violation_codes.per_key_error: An unknown or invisible key fails the request instead of being omitted.
violation_codes.id_limit_not_enforced: A request with more than 100 collection_ids in total is answered with listed instead of a VALIDATION_ERROR task error.
violation_codes.selector_mismatch: A returned card matches none of the request's selectors.
violation_codes.filter_mismatch: A returned card fails a request filter.
violation_codes.invisible_entry_returned: A returned card is not visible to the caller (no account, or another account).
violation_codes.missing_entry: A complete page omits a visible card that matches the selectors and filters.
violation_codes.duplicate_key: A key appears more than once on a page.
violation_codes.copy_inconsistent: A returned card differs from the seller's card for that key, the copy include_collections and webhooks serve.
violation_codes.token_scope_mismatch: The seller answers unchanged to a token issued for a different scope.
violation_codes.cache_scope_without_account: A request without account is answered with cache_scope account.
violation_codes.undeclared_event_type: The webhook's type is not in the seller's wholesale_feed_webhooks.event_types.
violation_codes.unsubscribed_event_type: The webhook's type is not in the subscriber's registered event_types.
violation_codes.account_mismatch: account_id differs from the account that registered the subscription.
violation_codes.visibility_leak: collection_card.updated carries a card the subscriber's account cannot see through list_collections.
